title: e2ee-drop
headline: Receive files securely, without the server seeing the contents
lead: Create a receive link and share it with the sender. Files are encrypted in the sender's browser and can only be opened in yours.
noAccountNeeded: No account needed. The link expires after 24 hours.
illustrationCaption: The same four words for you and the sender mean the file goes to the right key.
step1Body: Your browser creates a key pair. The private key never leaves this device.
step2Body: Send the link to the sender and compare the four verification words, for example over the phone.
step3Body: Once the file is uploaded, it's decrypted locally in your browser and deleted from the server.
dashboardDescription: Your links and what's waiting to be picked up.
filterLabel: Filter by where the key lives
noActiveLinks: You have no active links yet.
browserLinksFootnote: Links with the key in this browser only show up in the browser that made them.
codewordsReloginRequired: Log in again to see your links' verification words — your key isn't unlocked in this tab.
